evals.prompt: Run the three-tier test on my Cal Tracker app
evals.expected_output: Skill runs tier 1 (Playwright over Expo web), then tier 2 (Maestro flow on simulator), then tier 3 (manual checklist on physical device). Writes each result to TEST_RESULTS.md. Refuses to mark the build READY unless all three tiers pass within the last 72 hours.

evals.prompt: Verify my FloodPulse mobile build before I submit
evals.expected_output: Skill enforces the tier sequence. Refuses to proceed to tier 2 if tier 1 fails. Refuses to proceed to tier 3 if tier 2 fails. Final status written to TEST_RESULTS.md with timestamps.

evals.prompt: Is the pomodoro app ready to ship
evals.expected_output: Skill reads TEST_RESULTS.md. Confirms all three tiers passed within 72 hours. If yes, prints READY with the valid-until date. If no, lists the failing or stale tier and refuses.
